findings.title: Absolute legacy main is relocated inside package and receives verified:true
findings.observation: Pinned require.resolve selects the absolute main outside evaluated root. Kernel instead analyzes node_modules/vendor/tmp/.../absolute-target.js; both runSemanticBoundary and its recomputation report PROVEN with validation.valid=true and two proofs. CLI is INCOMPLETE/exit1 for MODULE_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY but installed content MATCH is marked verified:true with semantic PROVEN and zero semantic unknowns.
findings.nativeSemantics: Pinned native tryPackage uses path.resolve(requestPath,pkg), lines501-511; an absolute pkg replaces requestPath.
findings.impact: The semantic proof and installed verified bit attest a harmless substitute rather than the selected implementation; global INCOMPLETE does not make the proof consumable.
findings.requiredRepair: Conservatively reject absolute/unmodelled legacy main values before package-relative construction and proof publication. Add physical CLI/kernel regression with native resolve-only oracle. No new positive profile is necessary.

findings.title: CJS LOAD_AS_FILE precedence is absent before legacy package-directory selection
findings.observation: With vendor/package.json legacy main entry and sibling node_modules/vendor.js, pinned require.resolve selects vendor.js containing finite concatenated product import. Kernel selects vendor/entry.js and returns PROVEN/validation.valid=true, installed PROVEN, two proof IDs and no unknowns. CLI aborts exit2 ENOTDIR before producing a JSON report; this is not a demonstrated global PASS.
findings.nativeSemantics: Pinned Module._findPath resolves exports first, then basePath/tryExtensions before tryPackage, lines731-778. Repair guards check key directories and file-entry suffixes after choosing the directory, missing sibling file precedence.
findings.impact: The standalone semantic API can certify a body different from the one the closed CJS runtime selects. The separate CLI acquisition error masks this proof defect in this fixture.
findings.requiredRepair: Before deriving a legacy bare-package entry, reject unmodelled native file candidates at applicable search locations. Preserve exports-first precedence and S03 exact-exports positive. Add kernel and CLI controlled regressions without target execution.
